question: Post-partum family planning counselling is most effectively initiated during the third-trimester antenatal visit rather than immediately after delivery, because the antenatal period provides adequate time for discussion without the stress of the post-delivery period.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Initiating PPFP counselling antenatally (third trimester) is recommended because: (1) the woman is not in active labour/recovery stress, (2) family members may be present and can participate, and (3) it enables consent and planning for time-sensitive methods like PPIUCD (placed within 48 h of delivery).
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. WHO and MOHFW guidelines recommend initiating post-partum family planning (PPFP) counselling in the third trimester during ANC — specifically to allow unhurried informed decision-making before the time pressure and physical stress of the immediate post-delivery period, when LARC methods like PPIUCD must be placed within 48 hours.
